provider_contract: VA Veteran Confirmation API v1, POST /status (OpenAPI read 2026-11-10)

environments.LOCAL: fixture, or sandbox with an LLC-owned sandbox key
environments.STAGING: sandbox only, synthetic VA test identities only
environments.PRODUCTION: disabled; no request may be sent

firstName.source: typed by the Veteran on the Verify form for this attempt; not read from the profile
firstName.normalization: trim; curly apostrophe to straight apostrophe; nothing else rewritten

lastName.source: typed by the Veteran on the Verify form for this attempt; not read from the profile
lastName.normalization: trim; curly apostrophe to straight apostrophe; nothing else rewritten

birthDate.source: typed by the Veteran on the Verify form (month, day, year) for this attempt
birthDate.validation: a real calendar date strictly before today (UTC)

streetAddressLine1.source: typed by the Veteran on the Verify form: current address or where they get mail

city.source: typed by the Veteran on the Verify form

state.source: chosen by the Veteran on the Verify form
state.normalization: two-letter postal code from the web list: the 50 states, DC and five territories; no APO/FPO/DPO codes (contributor default, owner question in V1_MVP_PROPOSAL.md R9.1 details item 10)

country.validation: must equal USA if the client sends it

zipCode.source: typed by the Veteran on the Verify form

prohibited_fields: SSN or any part of it
any field not in allowed_field_names (the request is refused, not forwarded)
any value enriched from Case, Check-In, Trusted Circle, clinical, benefits or provider data
transience: Held in server memory for one attempt only, then dropped. Never stored, logged, traced, put in a Domain Event, Audit Event payload, notification, idempotency record, error text, browser storage, URL or client cache. The browser holds the values in page memory only and clears them on VERIFIED.

derived_values_kept.identity_hash: HMAC-SHA256 under SUAS_FINGERPRINT_KEY, label suas/identity/v1, over identity_canonical_form; stored with identity_key_id on every attempt VA answered (VA_CONFIRMATION_FLOW.md §2.2)
derived_values_kept.idempotency_fingerprint: HMAC-SHA256 under SUAS_FINGERPRINT_KEY over the projection and the caller id; stored with its key id; expires after 24 hours (VA_CONFIRMATION_FLOW.md §2.1)

retention: Result rows: D-007, not decided; no duration invented. Projection values: none kept.

identity_canonical_form.rule: Name: first name followed directly by last name, as one string. Lowercase; Unicode NFKD; strip combining marks; fold letters NFKD keeps whole (ß→ss, æ→ae, œ→oe, ø→o, ł→l, đ→d, ð→d, þ→th, ı→i, ŋ→n); then remove every character outside a-z. Birth date as ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Join name|birth_date with the character |. The name is one string so that a name split differently between the first and last fields ("Mary Jane" + "Smith" or "Mary" + "Jane Smith") gives the same value.

approval_record: evidence/d035/va-confirmation-v1-required-only.approval.json (holds the approver, the time and this file's SHA-256; this file holds no approval fields)
